# Script declaration

Every script starts with exactly one `strategy()` or `indicator()` call at the top level.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`strategy()`](#strategy) | Declares the script a strategy: it can trade. |
| [`indicator()`](#indicator) | Declares the script an indicator: it only draws. |

### strategy() {#strategy}

```ts
strategy(config: StrategyConfig): void
```

Declares the script a strategy: it can trade. Call it exactly once, at the top level.

Types: [StrategyConfig](#strategyconfig)

### indicator() {#indicator}

```ts
indicator(config: IndicatorConfig): void
```

Declares the script an indicator: it only draws. Call it exactly once, at the top level.

Types: [IndicatorConfig](#indicatorconfig)

## Types

### StrategyConfig {#strategyconfig}

Configuration of a strategy script (`strategy()`).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `version?` | `"0.1"` |  |
| `market` | [`Market`](./types#market) | the subnet traded; on the AlphaForge chart the chart's subnet replaces it |
| `resolution` | [`Resolution`](./types#resolution) | bar size; on the AlphaForge chart the chart's interval replaces it |
| `capital?` | `{ tao: number }` | starting cash (default 100 TAO); the Strategy tester's capital setting overrides it when set |
| `actOn?` | [`ActOn`](./types#acton) | when `event.onCandle` fires (default "confirmed") |
| `calcOnEveryBlock?` | `boolean` | also call `event.onBarUpdate` on every update of the open bar |
| `fill?` | [`FillConfig`](#fillconfig) |  |
| `fees?` | [`FeeConfig`](#feeconfig) |  |
| `risk?` | [`RiskConfig`](#riskconfig) |  |
| `overlay?` | `boolean` |  |

### IndicatorConfig {#indicatorconfig}

Configuration of an indicator script (`indicator()`).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `shortTitle?` | `string` | legend title on the chart (e.g. "BB" for Bollinger Bands); defaults to `name` |
| `version?` | `"0.1"` |  |
| `overlay?` | `boolean` | true: drawn on the price pane; false: in its own pane below the chart |
| `resolution?` | [`Resolution`](./types#resolution) |  |
| `precision?` | `number` | decimals of the values in the legend and on the price scale; default: the symbol's |
| `format?` | `"price" \| "percent" \| "volume"` | how values are formatted: price (default), percent, volume (k/M suffixes) |
| `titleInputs?` | `string[]` | names of the inputs shown in the legend title, in order; default: every int/float/source/select input |

### FillConfig {#fillconfig}

How intents fill in a backtest. The fill mode itself (quick, precise or 1B) is chosen in the Strategy tester's settings.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode?` | `"quick" \| "precise"` | not read by the runtime; the Strategy tester's fill setting decides |
| `latencyBlocks?` | `number` | blocks between intent creation and earliest fill (default 2) |
| `defaultToleranceBps?` | `number` | default max/min price tolerance when an intent gives none (default 100) |
| `rateLimitBlocks?` | `number` | stake rate limit between ops on one market (default from chain params) |

### FeeConfig {#feeconfig}

Trading fees, in basis points of the TAO side.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protocolBps?` | `number` | the chain's protocol fee (default: the chain parameter) |
| `platformBps?` | `number` | an extra platform fee added to every fill (default 0) |

### RiskConfig {#riskconfig}

Risk limits. Order-level rules reject the intent with reason `risk:<rule>`; drawdown and daily loss stop the run.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxPriceImpactPct?` | `number` | reject a fill whose price impact exceeds this percentage |
| `maxOrderTao?` | `number` | reject a buy larger than this many TAO |
| `maxPositionTao?` | `number` | reject a buy that would take the position's cost above this many TAO |
| `maxDailyLossTao?` | `number` | stop the run when equity falls this many TAO below the start of the UTC day |
| `maxDrawdownPct?` | `number` | stop the run when equity falls this percentage below its peak |
| `maxIntentsPerHour?` | `number` | reject new intents past this many in the last hour of blocks |
| `minPoolTao?` | `number` | reject fills while the pool holds less than this many TAO |
| `killSwitch?` | `boolean` | reject every new intent |
